stem_text: A body of mass 2 kg begins to move under the influence of time dependent force F^ = (2t i^ + 6t^2 j^) N, where i^ and j^ are unit vectors along x and y-axis respectively. The power produced by the force at t = 2 s is _____ W.

candidate_solve.derivation: Mass m = 2 kg. F(t) = 2t i^ + 6t^2 j^ N. Acceleration a(t) = F(t)/m = t i^ + 3t^2 j^ m/s^2. Since body begins to move from rest, v(0) = 0. Velocity v(t) = int_0^t a(t') dt' = (t^2 / 2) i^ + t^3 j^ m/s. At t = 2 s: F(2) = 2(2) i^ + 6(4) j^ = 4 i^ + 24 j^ N. v(2) = (4/2) i^ + (8) j^ = 2 i^ + 8 j^ m/s. Instantaneous power: P = F(2) . v(2) = (4)(2) + (24)(8) = 8 + 192 = 200 W.
